trades.name: Lower high below 6408.5-6411
trades.quote: Short a lower high below 6408.5-6411 looking for 6392-6396 and 6387.5. I would be on relatively thin runners by then unless the NQ seller has clearly returned. This is an A/A- setup.

trades.name: LBAF (quick sweep) of 6385.5 swing low holding 6375-6383
trades.quote: I’ll look for longs if we get a quick sweep of the 6385.5 swing low that holds 75-83 and sees a strong bid return. I’ll target 6408.5-6411 with runners for continuation. This is a B+/A- setup

trades.name: Higher low in 6392-6396
trades.quote: I may look for longs in the 6392-6396 range as a higher low relative to the 85.5 low. I’m not looking to bid this directly but if there is supportive session information then I’ll look for an entry. An example of this might be the IB low setting in or just above that range and I work against the IB low or on a LBAF. I’ll rate this a B/B+ and higher if there is supportive session information in my favor.
trades.stop_hint: I’m not looking to bid this directly

trades.name: LAAF of today's high (rejection of 6431-6435)
trades.quote: I’ll consider a short on a LAAF of today’s high as it would represent a rejection of 6431-6435. I believe that stronger sellers would not allow this (and frankly wouldn’t have allowed ES to even rally this far) so I would be rather cautious with this and keep it tight until 6408.5-6411 is lost and offered. I still have to rate this a B setup because of the importance of 6431-6435 but I would keep an extremely tight leash on it.
trades.stop_hint: keep it tight until 6408.5-6411 is lost and offered ... I would keep an extremely tight leash on it.
